pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with softened, smooth edge gradients at the pixel level. Patches exhibit sub-rectangular to trapezoidal geometries on the mid-flank, becoming narrower and more elongated towards the anterior neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating the patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-polar. The pathway thickness is thin and relatively uniform, representing approximately 10-20% of the adjacent patch width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of short, dark hair along the upper cervical and thoracic ridge, creating a jagged interface against the sky.
